Nerja, la perla de la Costa del Sol: Nerja, the pearl of the Costa del Sol
Un pueblo con encanto entre el mar y la: A charming town between sea and mountains, with a privileged microclimate and light all year round.
Nerja se asienta donde la sierra de Almi: Nerja sits where the Almijara mountains drop down to the Mediterranean, and that embrace of mountain and sea gives it a mild microclimate: pleasant temperatures almost all year and plenty of sunny days.
Su balcón sobre el mar, el famoso Balcón: Its balcony over the sea, the famous Balcón de Europa, is the heart of town: a palm-lined promenade on a clifftop with postcard views, perfect at sunset.
A las afueras están las Cuevas de Nerja,: On the outskirts are the Caves of Nerja, one of Andalusia's great natural treasures, with vast halls of stalactites and concerts held inside. And for the nostalgic, this is the town where the classic Spanish series "Verano Azul" was filmed.
Desde las playas urbanas del pueblo hast: From the town beaches to the unspoilt coves of Maro. Where to go and where to park.
En el propio pueblo: la Playa de la Torr: In town: La Torrecilla beach (the closest to home, about 12 min on foot), El Playazo (long and calm, with plenty of space) and Burriana, the liveliest, with beach bars where you can eat espetos and fried fish by the water.
Rincones con encanto: la pequeña cala de: Charming corners: the small Calahonda cove below the Balcón, and El Chucho or Carabeo beach, a little more hidden and less crowded.
Calas vírgenes: el paraje natural de Mar: Unspoilt coves: the Maro-Cerro Gordo natural area, a few minutes away by car, hides some of the prettiest coves in the south — Maro, Cañuelo, Las Alberquillas — with crystal-clear water, perfect for snorkelling and kayaking.
Aparcamiento: en verano conviene llegar: Parking: in summer it's best to arrive early. In Burriana and Maro there are paid car parks near the access points; on weekdays and early in the morning it's much easier to find a spot.
Marisco y pescaíto, carnes, tapas, paell: Seafood and fried fish, grilled meats, tapas, paella by the sea, Italian spots and places with a view.
Pescado y marisco: los chiringuitos de B: Fish and seafood: the beach bars of Burriana are a safe bet for sardine espetos, Málaga-style fried fish and rice dishes right by the sea.
Carnes y tapas: en las calles del centro: Meat and tapas: in the streets of the centre you'll find good grills and the classic Andalusian tapas trail, with bars where a beer always comes with something tasty.
Paellas y arroces: varios restaurantes j: Paella and rice: several beachfront restaurants do them beautifully, especially at lunchtime; it's worth booking in high season.
Otras cocinas: Nerja tiene una comunidad: Other cuisines: Nerja has a lively international community, so there's no shortage of good Italian places, fusion cooking and charming spots with sea views for a special dinner.
Dónde empezar el día: tostadas con tomat: Where to start the day: toast with tomato, molletes, pastries and coffee with a view.
Para el clásico andaluz —tostada con tom: For the Andalusian classic — toast with tomato and olive oil, or a mollete — there are great cafés in the centre and near the Balcón de Europa.
Si te gusta desayunar con calma, busca l: If you like a leisurely breakfast, look for terraces with sea views: coffee, freshly squeezed juice and the Mediterranean as a backdrop. A great plan before heading down to the beach.
Frigiliana, El Acebuchal, Torrox, Cómpet: Frigiliana, El Acebuchal, Torrox, Cómpeta, Comares… the Axarquía just a step away.
Frigiliana: a solo 10 minutos, uno de lo: Frigiliana: just 10 minutes away, one of the prettiest villages in Spain — a maze of white lanes, flowers and corners with views. A must.
El Acebuchal: el \"pueblo del fantasma\": El Acebuchal: the "ghost village", a hamlet restored amid the mountains, perfect for a country lunch on a weekend.
Torrox, Cómpeta y Comares: pueblos blanc: Torrox, Cómpeta and Comares: white villages of the Axarquía surrounded by vineyards and olive groves, with spectacular viewpoints and plenty of moscatel wine. Ideal for a half-day drive.
Cómo llegar desde Málaga, dónde aparcar: How to get here from Málaga, where to park and how to get around Nerja during your stay.
En coche: Nerja está a una hora de Málag: By car: Nerja is an hour from Málaga and its airport via the A-7. Our street, Joaquín Herrera, is a quiet residential area where street parking is usually easy; there are also public car parks towards the centre.
En autobús: ALSA conecta Málaga y el aer: By bus: ALSA connects Málaga and the airport with Nerja's bus station directly and frequently.
Nerja se disfruta a pie: desde casa lleg: Nerja is best enjoyed on foot: from the apartment you can walk to the beach, the centre and the Balcón de Europa. For the Maro coves and the white villages, a car is most convenient.
